segments.sn48.50:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā aṅgesu viharati āpaṇaṃ nāma aṅgānaṃ nigamo.
segments.sn48.50:1.3: Tatra kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āmantesi –
segments.sn48.50:1.4: “yo so, sāriputta, ariyasāvako tathāgate ekantagato [ekantigato (sī.)] abhippasanno, na so tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā kaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vā”ti?
segments.sn48.50:2.1: “Yo so, bhante, ariyasāvako tathāgate ekantagato abhippasanno, na so tathāgate vā tathāgatasāsane vā kaṅkheyya vā vicikiccheyya vā.
segments.sn48.50:2.2: Saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa evaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ āraddhavīriyo viharissati – akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya, kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya, thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu. Yaṃ hissa, bhante, vīriyaṃ tadassa vīriyindriyaṃ. “Saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ satimā bhavissati, paramena satinepakkena samannāgato, cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā.
segments.sn48.50:3.2: Yā hissa, bhante, sati tadassa satindriyaṃ.
segments.sn48.50:4.1: “Saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ vossaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhissati samādhiṃ, labhissati cittassa ekaggataṃ.
segments.sn48.50:4.2: Yo hissa, bhante, samādhi tadassa samādhindriyaṃ.
segments.sn48.50:5.1: “Saddhassa hi, bhante, ariyasāvakassa āraddhavīriyassa upaṭṭhitassatino samāhitacittassa etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ yaṃ evaṃ pajānissati – anamataggo kho saṃsāro.
segments.sn48.50:5.3: Pubbā koṭi na paññāyati avijjānīvaraṇānaṃ sattānaṃ taṇhāsaṃyojanānaṃ sandhāvataṃ saṃsarataṃ.
segments.sn48.50:5.4: Avijjāya tveva tamokāyassa asesavirāganirodho santametaṃ padaṃ paṇītametaṃ padaṃ, yadidaṃ – sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabbūpadhipaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo virāgo nirodho nibbānaṃ [nibbānanti (?)].
segments.sn48.50:5.6: Yā hissa, bhante, paññā tadassa paññindriyaṃ.
segments.sn48.50:6.1: “Saddho so [sa kho so (sī. syā. kaṃ.)], bhante, ariyasāvako evaṃ padahitvā padahitvā evaṃ saritvā saritvā evaṃ samādahitvā samādahitvā evaṃ pajānitvā pajānitvā evaṃ abhisaddahati –
segments.sn48.50:6.2: ‘ime kho te dhammā ye me pubbe sutavā ahesuṃ.
segments.sn48.50:6.3: Tenāhaṃ etarahi kāyena ca phusitvā viharāmi, paññāya ca ativijjha [paṭivijjha (sī. ka.) tadaṭṭhakathāsu pana ativijjhitvāti vaṇṇitaṃ] passāmī’ti.
segments.sn48.50:6.4: Yā hissa, bhante, saddhā tadassa saddhindriyan”ti.

segments.sn48.50:12.3: Pubbārāme ca cattāri, piṇḍolo āpaṇena cāti [saddhena te dasāti (syā. kaṃ. ka.)].

lines: Dasame ime kho te dhammāti upari saha vipassanāya tayo maggā.
Ye me pubbe sutāva ahesunti ye dhammā mayā pubbe “arahattaphalindriyaṃ nāma atthī”ti kathentānaṃyeva sutā ahesuṃ.
Kāyena ca phusitvāti nāmakāyena ca phusitvā paṭilabhitvā.
Paññāya ca ativijjha passāmīti paccavekkhaṇapaññāya ca ativijjhitvā passāmi.
Catūhi indriyehi sampayuttā saddhā heṭṭhā kathitāva, ayaṃ pana paccavekkhaṇasaddhā.
Upari saha vipassanāya tayo maggāti vipassanāya saha sotāpattiphalato upari tayo maggā.
Maggādhigamena idāni paccakkhabhūtattā “ime kho te dhammā”ti vuttā.
Tattha yaṃ aggabhūtaṃ, tassa vasena dassetuṃ “arahattaphalindriyaṃ nāmā”ti vuttaṃ indriyabhāvasāmaññena ekajjhaṃ katvā.
